headline: Mass Shooting Reported In Krakow Market Square Leaves Five Dead
seoTitle: Five Dead In Krakow Market Shooting
metaDescription: At least five people were killed and over a dozen injured following a shooting incident in Krakow's main market square. Polish authorities investigate.
aiSummaryBullets: A gunman fired at people from a vehicle in the main market square of Krakow.
Local authorities confirmed that five individuals were killed in the incident.
Over a dozen people sustained injuries and are receiving medical attention.
aiContextParagraph: On November 7, 2026, a mass shooting occurred in the main market square of Krakow, Poland, resulting in the deaths of at least five individuals. Reports indicate that the assailant operated a vehicle in the square while firing at pedestrians. Police are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the event, which has prompted condemnation from national leadership and international representatives. Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the incident as a tragic shooting, while the United States Ambassador to Poland, Tom Rose, issued a statement expressing solidarity with the victims and the city. As of the latest reports, more than a dozen people were wounded during the attack. The city of Krakow, which serves as the second-largest urban center in Poland, remains the focus of an active security response following the violence.
